name: Definitions
description: What a piece of source declares, read from the syntax tree.

scenarios.title: A name carries the scopes holding it
given: a file nesting a module inside a module
scenarios.when: the file is read for what it declares
scenarios.then: each name answers qualified by the scopes it sits in

scenarios.title: A singleton method and an instance one
given: a class declaring one of each
scenarios.when: the file is read for what it declares
scenarios.then: the two are told apart by the way Ruby spells them

scenarios.title: A scope written with its path
given: a module named the way a path is written rather than by nesting
scenarios.when: the file is read for what it declares
scenarios.then: the name answers whole, as the source spelled it

scenarios.title: A definition outside every scope
given: a method declared at the top level of a file
scenarios.when: the file is read for what it declares
scenarios.then: it answers by its bare name, because there is no path to put in front of it

scenarios.title: A file that is not Ruby
scenarios.when: the file is read for what it declares

scenarios.title: Source the grammar cannot read
given: a Ruby file the grammar cannot parse
scenarios.when: the file is read for what it declares
scenarios.then: the file is named as unreadable rather than answering with the names it recovered
